annotations.title: Table of contents of an act

description: WHAT IS IN THIS ACT — its table of contents: books, titles, chapters and sections, each with the range of articles it holds. Use this when you need an article but do NOT know its number: guessing an article number is how a citation gets fabricated. Pass `part` with a division's name to list that division's articles individually with their opening words, then lookup_article for the text of the one you want. An act made of numbered POINTS instead of articles (the norms of a code, instructions, procedures) is listed the same way, by title, with its point ranges.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

part.description: Optional. One division to open, e.g. 'Titlul VII' or 'taxa pe valoarea adaugata'. Matched against the division names, diacritic-insensitively.
